page.overview:
Who is Biggob?

Biggob is the warboss of a tribe of Savage Orcs on the island of Albion. None can say for sure when he arrived on Albion, or in fact how he actually got there, but the precision behind his raids has led some to speculate that some other intelligence is guiding the tribe.

It is said that there is no corner of the mortal world where the Orcs do not gather in numbers. Even as the very first Dwarf troops marched inland through the treacherous swamps and quagmires that are common place on the recently revealed island of Albion, they found their progress hampered by frequent and ferocious attacks. The first such raid occurred when a tribe of Orcs appeared from the mists, bellowing guttural war cries.

They launched a surprise assault on an artillery train that had become bogged down on the muddy paths. The crews were waiting for reinforcements to pull them out of the mire but before the brave Dwarf Warriors had time to respond, the Orcs had overrun the convoy. They destroyed the guns and crew, before disappearing into the mists as quickly as they had emerged. The survivors talk of a massive tattooed Orc mounted on a huge boar. His weapon was a monstrous club made from the bone of some terrible beast and the Orcs who followed him to battle all yelled the name "Biggob!" as they charged into the heart of the Dwarf formation.

Biggob is the warboss of a tribe of Savage Orcs. None can say for sure when he arrived on Albion, or in fact how the Greenskins actually got there. Some think that his tribe has always existed there, others believe that his tribe are but a small part of a larger Orc horde. Whatever the truth behind his appearance on Albion, Biggob's attacks are proving most effective. In fact, the precision behind his raids has led to speculation that some other intelligence is guiding the tribe.
